hypothesis: PIT TTM cash-flow acceleration may sharpen the rejected cash-conversion quality lead by requiring current same-period TTM cash conversion to improve versus prior TTM, isolating earnings quality acceleration rather than static quality.
causal_components: PIT TTM same-period Companyfacts quality field

prediction.confidence_reason: The annual and TTM cash-conversion quality scouts were directionally strong but rejected on drawdown; requiring cash conversion to accelerate versus the prior comparable TTM is a distinct PIT Companyfacts field, not a deployment, stop, threshold, hold, cooldown, or notional retry.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual/YTD/prior comparable net_income or operating_cash_flow, missing assets, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT TTM cash-conversion acceleration gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
